Name: Seed Shop Filter
Author: CharaAftonStelle
Description:
SSF was created for those who, like me, are tired of confusing graphical interfaces after installing various seed mods; it allows you to disable any seed from any store that contains seeds.

Download the file and extract it to the mods folder. After running it once (and sometimes accessing a saved game), it will identify mod shops and mod seeds and save this information in a file.

Manifest.Name: Seed Shop Filter
Manifest.Description: Ativa ou desativa cada semente vendida em cada loja, pelo GMCM.
